description:
Power BI Report Server, available as part of Power BI Premium, enables on-premises web and mobile viewing of Power BI reports, plus the enterprise reporting capabilities of SQL Server Reporting Services.


- Added support for Encrypt=Strict and MultiSubnetFailover options for report server database connections in Power BI Report Server Configuration Manager.
- Setup no longer installs the Microsoft Access Database Engine. To use Access or Excel data sources, install the Access Database Engine on the report server.
- Fixed issue where failover cluster patching could create duplicate SQL Agent job names, requiring manual cleanup before schedules would work again.
- Fixed issue where a report could stop responding when its query began with a multi-line comment.
- Various bug fixes.
